about: Day 2's feed (3 Nov), newest on top: same post shape as content/feed.json, shown at /day-2.

blocks.text: I've always had trouble putting websites together, so last night I labelled every chunk of content: my LinkedIn posts, your team's, your website, hours and hours of transcripts. Then I could say: I hate the structure, give me three versions, and build a story that makes sense for each page. It did a really good job, and it's actually new, so I'll be using it after this. About 25 euros of build so far; the goal is a couple of euros a piece, for something that makes whoever gets it think they're your top account. This is what outreach looks like in 2026.
